source_access_basis.scope_decision: One ordinary public published-job HTML page linked by its documented public API; not blanket HTML permission or general ATS support.

field_contract.jobID: Locked numeric ID from published API URL; canonical host/path/query and application action agree
field_contract.title: One h1, matching og:title and document title
field_contract.employer: Document title suffix at Greenhouse, verified against public API company_name
field_contract.location: One job__location text node, matching og:description
field_contract.applicationURL: Observed application-form action resolved against approved HTTPS source; hosted form page only, no submission
field_contract.sourcePostedDate: No posting-date marker in this raw HTML contract; null; API first_published not transplanted

canonical_behavior: Check exact same host/path/query; retain HTTP discrepancy as metadata; never fetch or use HTTP canonical for records
applicationURL_semantics: Observed hosted form page, same as source URL; no submission endpoint or submitted application validated
empty_state: No legitimate empty contract for this known detail page. Missing page, zero required markers, challenge/error HTML, duplicate or conflicting markers produce incomplete failure, not removals.
refresh: Not part of this single-post test
remote_target_redirect_path: Not established by local NoRedirect; source direct GET was 200 without redirect

full_source_HTML.retention: Full employer HTML is withheld; only field projection and measured receipt/bytes/hash are distributed.

owned_source_shaped_fixture.scope: Hand-authored structure plus public field facts; no copied description/form fields/scripts/tracking; not genuine HTML bytes

official_feed_direct_HTTP_alternative: Public job JSON and raw HTML already supply relevant facts; managed retrieval is an optional path acceptance test, not a demonstrated necessity.
pre_persistence_credential_echo_guard: Reject plain, HTML-entity and JSON-escaped key echoes in body/allowlisted headers/receipt; do not retain unsafe body or values; keep safe status/hash/known receipt only.

semantic_preflight_acceptance.required: Complete one selected posting layout and exact independent literal record
semantic_preflight_acceptance.full_body_hash_and_byte_equality: diagnostic only; wrapper or tracking nonce drift may change bytes without changing acceptance
semantic_preflight_acceptance.source_provenance: Recorded direct public acquisition, distinct from local semantic validation.
semantic_preflight_acceptance.truncation: reject missing/mismatched form closure, missing HTML closure, unfinished field markers and oversized prefix

live_semantic_acceptance.required: exact independent literal record except observedUTC
live_semantic_acceptance.mismatch: retain parsed record and known receipt but accepted=false

credit_header_policy: Inspect every allowlisted header value for echoes. Duplicate/ambiguous credit receipts are unknown/null and unaccepted, even if identical; never select the first amount.
portable_example_scope: Parser/one-dispatch observation functions adapted from the accepted one-call helper; public CLI and runner are offline only. The public CLI was not used for the recorded paid acquisition.
